payload.author: framework-coordinator
source_evidence: src/win.h declares bring_parent_to_top as static cdecl: the original accepts one explicit stack window and no hidden receiver. src/win.cpp uses actual flags and Win pointers, retains stable root ordering and reloads count/target after recursion. Static source ownership is the minimal ABI-backed model, not a claim that the original spelling was static rather than free.

Win::show calls the root operation explicitly and rechecks WinRootCount on every traversal continuation, while refreshing WinZOrderWindow only after recursion. The right-button body remains unchanged and its call now follows the corrected helper declaration. Native bindings restore both lost original identities and unclaimed spans with separate measured emitted-symbol facts.

recovery/tests/win_root_order_harness.cpp injects both live bodies and the real static declaration. It covers root guards/order, missing and hidden roots, callback shrink/growth and target changes, parent routing and show guards; private damage cases reintroduce stale callback state. test_control_globals.py checks both real compiled callers reclaim one argument and the helper returns without callee stack cleanup. These are bounded behavior and ABI controls, not real object-layout, right-button behavior, root-array extent or game acceptance.

The coupled defect is incorporated without demoting or banking claims. Broader Win lifetime/storage recovery, strict target verification and instruction matching remain open; all other discoveries and original task baseline remain unchanged.
